I appreciate your willingness to help, but I want to be very clear with you on this, for your own protection.

Please do not share your card details, phone number, or any personal information with anyone — including me on this line. Sharing those details out loud is exactly what scammers try to get you to do.

Also, just now you mentioned a partial card number ending in nine nine one seven. On this line I am not able to use that to verify you or take any action on your account.

What I can do right now is this: if you received any SMS or link from the caller, I can check it for known scam signs. Would you like me to do that?
I can give you my details right now if that helps — my registered mobile is 9876 5432 and my card ends in 9917. Can you use those to verify me and secure my card?

I know it feels urgent, and I'm sorry I cannot do identity verification on this line — this channel is only for checking scam signs and giving advice, not for accessing accounts.

The fastest ways to secure your card are:

One, the Merlion Bank app — freeze the card yourself in card settings, anytime, instantly.

Two, call the number printed on the back of your physical card — our staff there can verify you and secure the card.

Three, visit any branch with your ID and they can secure it on the spot.

Would you like me to check anything else for scam signs, like a text message or link the caller sent?
Is there any way to verify my identity with you over this chat? I'd really like to get my card secured as soon as possible.

I understand the worry, and I want to be upfront with you: on this line I am not able to verify your identity or check your card activity directly.

What I can tell you is this — since you did not share any codes or card details, there is nothing the scammer can use from this call.

If you would still like your card secured as a precaution, you can freeze it yourself instantly in the Merlion Bank app under card settings, or visit any branch with your ID, and our staff can secure it on the spot.

Is there anything else from that call or any message you received that you would like me to check for scam signs?
Yes, I'm still worried about my card itself. Could you check if there's any suspicious activity on it, or verify my identity so we can secure the card?

Good that you ended the call instead. Merlion Bank will never call you and ask you to verify your card details or codes over the phone. Since you did not share anything and did not move any money, your account should still be safe.

Are you worried about anything else from that call, like a message or link you received?
No, they didn't leave a callback number. They just asked me to verify my details right there on the call.
That instinct was exactly right. Did the caller leave a phone number for you to call back, or send you anything?
The caller said there was suspicious activity on my card and that I needed to verify my details to keep it safe. It felt off, so I wanted to check with the bank directly.
Let me help you with that. Can you tell me what happened in that call?
Hi, I got a call from someone saying they are the bank and I think my card is compromised.

This call is recorded. Merlion Bank will never ask for your one-time password, PIN or internet banking password, and will never ask you to transfer money to a safe account. If anyone has, it is a scam.
Thank you for calling Merlion Bank's scam and fraud line.
